title: Special Executive Programme In Analysing Risk Environmental
description: Develop expertise in identifying, managing, and mitigating business risks through effective risk management strategies.
longDescription: This programme explores the role of risk management within organizations, focusing on business risks and their impact. Participants will learn about risk control strategies, risk financing, and the techniques for assessing and mitigating organizational risks.
courseDetails: Understand the Various Types of Organisation Risk. Understand the Concept of Strategic Risk. Understand the Concept of Financial Risks. Understand the Concept of Operational Risk. Understand the Concept of Hazard Risks. Understand the Concept of Information Security Risk. Understand the Various Activities of High Risk in the Business Organisation. Identify Organisational Risks: Recognise and Categorise Potential Risks that May Pose Threats to an Organisation's Success and Operations. Explore Risk Control Strategies: Investigate Various Risk Control Techniques Such as Preventive, Detective, and Corrective Measures to Proactively Manage and Mitigate Identified Risks. Analyse Risk Control Effectiveness: Evaluate the Efficiency and Effectiveness of Implemented Risk Control Measures in Reducing the Likelihood and Impact of Organisational Risks. Understand Risk Financing Concepts: Comprehend the Basic Principles of Risk Financing and its Role in Addressing the Financial Consequences of Potential Risks. Explore Risk Financing Options: Investigate Different Risk Financing Options Including Insurance, Self-insurance, and Risk Retention to Determine Suitable Approaches for Handling Specific Organisational Risks. Understand the Techniques for Identifying Risks (E.G., SWOT Analysis, Risk Registers, Brainstorming) and Qualitative vs. Quantitative Risk Assessment. Learn Risk Scoring and Prioritisation Methods. Assess the Potential Impacts of Various Risks on Business Operations Known as Business Impact Assessment and Prioritise Critical Functions and Resources. Learn to Develop a Comprehensive Business Continuity Plan and Explore Emergency Response and Crisis Management Procedures. Analyse the Ways to Risk Monitoring and Control and Establish Key Risk Indicators and Triggers. The course begins by introducing the fundamentals of risk management, exploring different types of organizational risks including strategic, financial, operational, and hazard risks. Participants will analyze risk control techniques and evaluate the effectiveness of risk mitigation measures. The programme also delves into risk financing options such as insurance and self-insurance, and covers qualitative and quantitative risk assessment methods. Business continuity planning, emergency response, and crisis management procedures are also key components. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following: The Function of Risk Management in Organizations: Understanding Business Risks: Understanding Risk Control Through Risk Financing: Risk Assessment and its impact on Business:
